purpose: Freeze reference-label semantics before any future independent validation.

GO: Supportive efficacy with high body-level certainty.
Normally requires at least two independent concordant high-level syntheses, or an authoritative well-established-use regulatory/clinical monograph with direct applicability.
No material unresolved safety or regulatory blocker.
GO WITH CAUTION: Supportive efficacy but certainty below high, including a single synthesis, limited/small evidence body, explicit methodological limitation, or clinically relevant non-hard restriction.
Caution is not a failure state and must not be promoted to GO solely to increase agreement.
EXPERT REVIEW REQUIRED: Material conflict among credible evidence, such as supportive versus null/negative evidence at the governing tier, or a newer credible contradiction of older governing evidence.
Unknown/unclear evidence alone is not conflict.
A positive high-level synthesis plus an older lower-tier null study is not automatically expert-review conflict.
INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE: No demonstrated benefit, null governing evidence, very-low/insufficient evidence without a defensible supportive body, or unresolved direction without material opposing evidence.
NO GO SAFETY: Applicable serious safety risk established by structured safety evidence; zero serious-safety false negatives tolerated.
NO GO REGULATORY: Applicable current legal/marketability blocker, including prohibition, exceeded mandatory limit, or structured authorization state not_authorized/denied/terminated for the matched jurisdiction/product context.

anti_leakage: Rubric is frozen before future case labels are assigned.
Do not modify production rules to fit a frozen validation set.
Do not call uncertainty 'conflict' merely to fill the EXPERT REVIEW class.
Do not label single-synthesis supportive evidence as GO if the rubric would classify it as CAUTION.
